acceptanceCriteria: Qualified and rooted constant assignments are definitions in the resolved namespace and not references.
`Name ||= ...` is treated as a local definition.
Local definitions later in the file shadow references in earlier qualified reopens, or the limit is recorded as a spec failure mode.
Each case has a TestRubyAutoload* regression test.
body: Residuals from the PR #1088 review fixes (V1-1674, NGI-V0-017/018, internal/contextindex/ruby_autoload.go). Conservative (they add reports, never hide them): (1) `A::B = ...` and `::X = ...` are counted as references, not definitions; (2) a qualified class/module reopen sees only local definitions earlier in the file; (3) `Name ||= ...` is not a definition. Expected: each defines the constant in its lexical namespace and shadows the autoloaded one, like plain `Name =`.
title: Ruby autoload impact: qualified/rooted constant assignments, ||= and later local definitions mis-classified (V1-1674 residuals)
